title: Catalog Response
description: Response of GET /__remote_everything/apps for the node named in the X-Remote-Everything-Node header: what that node runs. A node that cannot be reached is answered as computer_offline here rather than as an error, so a client learns a node's state from one request.

ok.description: Always true for a valid catalog response.

computer_connected.description: Whether the gateway can reach the node. The gateway asks the node before answering, so this is what that node said about itself a moment ago.

code.description: Top-level status code. Must be 'ready' when computer_connected is true, 'computer_offline' when false.

apps.description: List of configured applications. Must be empty when computer is offline.

name.description: Display name, 1–80 code points, no control characters.

description.description: Short description, 0–240 code points, no control characters.

icon.description: Single-character or short emoji icon, 0–4 code points.

launch_fragment.description: URL fragment appended to the open URL. Empty or starts with #, max 2048 code points.

computer_connected.description: Must always be true for individual apps in a valid catalog.

running.description: Whether the application is currently running.

code.description: App state code. Must be consistent with enabled+running: ready (enabled+running), starting (enabled+!running), stopping (!enabled+running), stopped (!enabled+!running).
